name: kimi-voiceover-video
description: Turn a voice recording or a to-camera take into a fully animated, captioned, sound-designed short video — vertical, landscape, or square. Built for Kimi Code CLI with a customizable brand that defaults to Kimi violet.
author: Dancan254

interface.shortDescription: Voice note or talking-head take in, animated Short out
interface.longDescription: Drop in a voice note or a to-camera take and get a polished Short in vertical 1080x1920, landscape 1920x1080, or square 1080x1080: local word-level transcription, kinetic typography, camera moves, images, clips and memes, synthesized sound design and a voice-ducked music bed. With a talking-head recording, your hook and sign-off stay on camera while the middle is animated over your voice. It can pull the best 30-90s hook out of a long recording and generates posting thumbnails. The agent guides brand setup on first run and asks before the expensive render steps.
